testimonials.name: Nancy McInnis
testimonials.status: confirmed (approved by Tyler Nov 21, 2026; wording from old site, Dec 2024)
quote: Muddy York did a complete gut and build of my bathroom. I was advised it could take 2-4 weeks.

We have only one bathroom, and I was nervous about how long the project would take. I must have asked a hundred questions (I'm not exaggerating!), and they answered every one patiently and in layperson's terms I could understand.

I've been so happy about our bathroom that I've told everyone about it and showed them photos. I can tell from the look on their faces that they are waiting for me to rant about something that went wrong, but all I have are raves. Our project was in budget and on time. I know we'll do more work on our house, and Muddy York is the company I'll be calling!
testimonials.pull: Our project was in budget and on time.

testimonials.name: Erin
testimonials.status: confirmed (approved by Tyler Nov 21, 2026; wording from old site, Dec 2024)
quote: Dylan, Blake and Kyle were a fantastic team. Their painter, Rodney, and his crew were also great. I had Muddy York in my house, installing upstairs laundry, putting in walls and a mini kitchen, and working on my basement Airbnb.

They were very efficient and thoughtful, offering suggestions on cost savings and the best utility for my ideas. I was so happy with their work that I asked them to do smaller tasks around the house, which they completed beautifully. I'll request them if I need more work and recommend them to all my friends.
testimonials.pull: Very efficient and thoughtful, offering suggestions on cost savings.
